args.sql:
SELECT 
    ROUND(SQRT(2 * 6.67430E-11 * pm."massjup" * 1.898E27 / (pm."radjup" * 7.1492E7)) / 1000)::int AS escape_velocity
FROM physical_properties pm
ORDER BY (pm."massjup" * 317.83) / (pm."radjup" * 11.209) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    pm."massjup", 
    pm."radjup",
    (pm."massjup" * 317.83) / (pm."radjup" * 11.209) AS mrr
FROM physical_properties pm
WHERE pm."massjup" IS NOT NULL AND pm."radjup" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY mrr DESC
LIMIT 5;
